# xmatters_service_dependency (Resource)

Create a dependency between two existing xMatters services.

Service dependencies describe the relationship between a service and its direct dependent in your xMatters system. If a service has multiple dependencies or depends on multiple services, those relationships cannot currently be displayed in the request response via the xMatters REST API. To view multiple dependencies, use the service map in the xMatters web user interface.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Create a new service dependency in xMatters using the `xmatters_service_dependency` resource
resource "xmatters_service_dependency" "create_modify_service_dependency" {
  service_id           = "c0b5351e-3848-45c9-b1d3-c3bdad36517a"
  dependent_service_id = "ac523c52-4873-4883-8e51-760eb47cf6f9"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dependent_service_id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the dependent service.
- `service_id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of a service. This service is relied upon by the dependent service.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the service dependency.
- `last_updated` (String)
